reply.english: And you a thousand times well
And blessed Eid to you too

phrases.arabic: وَيْنَكُم؟ لِيش مَا جِيتُو تِعَيَّدُو مَعَنَا؟
phrases.transliteration: weinkum? leish ma jiitoo ti3ayyidoo ma3ana?

dialogue.speaker: سَارَة
dialogue.arabic: عِيدَك مُبارَك يَا أُمّ أَحْمَد!
dialogue.english: Blessed Eid, Umm Ahmad!

dialogue.speaker: أُمّ أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُبارِكُ فيك، كُلَّ عَامٍ وَ انْتِ بِخَيْر
dialogue.transliteration: allah ybaarek fiik, kull 3aam w-anti bikhair
dialogue.english: God bless you too, may you be well every year

dialogue.speaker: سَارَة
dialogue.arabic: عَسَاكِ مِنْ عَوَادُو
dialogue.english: May you witness it again next year

dialogue.speaker: أُمّ أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: وَ إِيَّاكِ، تَفَضَّلِي دَاخِل
dialogue.english: And you too, please come in

dialogue.speaker: سَارَة
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا، شُو هَاي الرِّيحَة الحِلْوَة؟
dialogue.english: Thanks, what's this lovely smell?

dialogue.speaker: أُمّ أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: سَوَّيْنَا مَعَمُول وَ كَعْك مِنْ أَمْس
dialogue.english: We made ma'mool and cookies since yesterday

dialogue.speaker: سَارَة
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُعْطِيكِ العَافِيَة، أَبِي وَاحِدَة!
dialogue.english: God give you strength, I want one!

dialogue.speaker: أُمّ أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: تَكَرَّمِي، خُذِي اللِّي تَبِينِيه
dialogue.english: You're welcome, take what you like

dialogue.speaker: سَارَة
dialogue.arabic: وَ الوَلاد وَيْنُهُم؟
dialogue.english: Where are the kids?

dialogue.speaker: أُمّ أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: رَايِحِينَ صَلاةُ العِيد مَعَ أَبُوهُم، الحِينَ بِرْجَعُو
dialogue.transliteration: raayHeen salaat l-3eed ma3 abuuhum, il-7een bireja3oo
dialogue.english: They went to the Eid prayer with their father, they'll be back soon

dialogue.speaker: سَارَة
dialogue.arabic: وَ أَنَا لاَزِم أَرُوح عِنْدِ جِدَّتِي، وَعَدْتِهَا أَزُورِهَا بُكْرَة الصُّبْح
dialogue.transliteration: w-ana laazim aroo7 3ind jiddati, wa3adtha azoorha bukra s-sub7
dialogue.english: And I have to go to my grandma's, I promised to visit her tomorrow morning

dialogue.speaker: أُمّ أَحْمَد
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يِحْفَظِك، سَلِّمِي لِي عَلَيْهَا وَ عِيدُهَا مُبارَك
dialogue.transliteration: allah yi7fathik, sallimi li 3aleiha w-3eedha mbaarak
dialogue.english: God protect you, greet her for me and blessed Eid to her

pair.english: May you be well every year

response.english: And you a thousand times well
And blessed Eid to you too

lessons.culture: بِالحِجَاز العِيد مُنَاسَبَة عَائِلِيَّة تَبْدَأ بِصَلاةِ العِيد صَبَاحًا وَ بَعْدُهَا الزِّيَارَات وَالْجَلْسَات. الكُلّ يِلْبَس ثِيَاب جَدِيدَة وَ الوِلاد يَاخُدُو عِيدِيَّة. البُيُوت فِيهَا مَعَمُول وَ كَعْك وَ قَهْوَة لِلضِّيُوف.

exercises.prompt: حَدّا قَالَك عِيدٌ مُبارَك، شُو بِتِرِدّ عَلَيْه؟

too_formal.item: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَ مِنْكُمْ صَالِحَ الأَعْمَال
too_formal.feedback: رِدّ فَصِيح طَوِيل بِيتِقَال بِالخُطَب، مش بِالحَكِي اليَومِي.

exercises.tip: هَالرِدّ بِيتِقَال لأَيّ حَدّا مِهْمَا كَان جِنْسُو.

exercises.prompt: كُلَّ عَامٍ وَ إِنْتُو ____

too_formal.feedback: صِيغَة فَصِيحَة مُزَخْرَفَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو بِخَيْر بَس.

exercises.tip: بِخَيْر هُنَا مَعْنَاهَا بِصِحَّة وَ سِعَادَة.

exercises.prompt: Blessed Eid to you all

too_formal.feedback: جَمِيعًا أَسْلُوب كِتَابِي، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو عِيدُكُم مُبارَك.

exercises.tip: كُم فِي آخِر الكِلْمَة تَعْنِي كُلُّكُم.

exercises.prompt: شُو اسْم الفُلُوس يِلِّي يِعْطُوهَا الكِبَار لِلوِلاد بِالعِيد؟

too_formal.feedback: هِبَة كِلْمَة فَصِيحَة، مَحَدّا بِيحْكِيهَا بِالشَّارِع.

exercises.tip: العِيدِيَّة عَادَة بِتَكُون فُلُوس جَدِيدَة بِظَرْف.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: We're going to the Eid prayer

too_formal.feedback: ذَاهِبُونَ كِلْمَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو رَايِحِينَ.

exercises.tip: صَلاة العِيد تَكُون بِالصَّبَاح بَاكِر.

exercises.prompt: عَسَاكِ مِنْ عَوَادُو، شُو مِمْكِن تِرِدِّي؟

too_formal.item: أَعَادَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَيْكُمْ بِاليُمْنِ وَالبَرَكَات
too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، نَادِر تِنْحَكَى هِيك بِالحَكِي اليَومِي.

exercises.tip: هَاد رِدّ بَسِيط وَ سَرِيع بِيتِقَال بِأَيّ مُنَاسَبَة مُشَابِهَة.

exercises.prompt: قَاعِد أِلْبَس ثِيَاب ____ الجَدِيدَة

too_formal.feedback: كِلْمَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو أِلْبَس أَو لاَبِس.

exercises.tip: قَاعِد قَبْل الفِعْل تَعْنِي إِنّك تِسْوِي الشَّي الحِينَ.

exercises.prompt: We went to my grandma today

too_formal.feedback: قُمْنَا بِزِيَارَة أَسْلُوب فَصِيح، وَالنَّاس يِقُولُو رُحْنَا عِنْدِهَا.

exercises.tip: عِنْدِ تَعْنِي عِنْدَ البَيْت أَو الدَّار.

exercises.prompt: شُو بِيحِضِّرُو كِتِير مِنَ البُيُوت لِلعِيد؟

too_formal.feedback: تَعْبِير عَام فَصِيح، مش اسْم أَكْلَة مُحَدَّدَة.

exercises.tip: المَعَمُول وَ الكَعْك بِيتِحَضِّرُو خَاصَّة لِلعِيد وَ بِتِتِوزَّع عَالجِيرَان.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: Blessed Eid to you all

too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة بَدِيلَة، مش المُترْجَمَة المَطْلُوبَة بِالتَّمْرِين.

exercises.tip: كُم ضَمِير الجَمْع بِآخِر الكِلْمَة.

dialogue.speaker: لَيْلَى
dialogue.arabic: رَمَضَانُ كَرِيم يَا خِيتُو!
dialogue.english: Ramadan is generous, sister

dialogue.speaker: هُدَى
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْرَم، كِيفِك يَا لَيْلَى؟
dialogue.english: God is more generous, how are you?

dialogue.speaker: لَيْلَى
dialogue.arabic: مِنِيحَة الحَمْدُ لِلَّه، إِنْتِ تِصُومِينَ؟
dialogue.english: Fine thank God, are you fasting?

dialogue.speaker: هُدَى
dialogue.arabic: إِيهِ، مِنْ أَوَّل يَوْم، مَا فَوِّتِت يَوْم
dialogue.transliteration: eeh, min awwal yoom, ma fawwet yoom
dialogue.english: Yes, since the first day, I haven't missed a day

dialogue.speaker: لَيْلَى
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُعْطِيكِ العَافِيَة، وَيْنِ بِتِفْطُرِي اليَوْم؟
dialogue.transliteration: allah yu3teek l-3aafya, ween bitefteri l-yoom?
dialogue.english: God give you strength, where will you break the fast today?

dialogue.speaker: هُدَى
dialogue.arabic: عِنْدِ أَهْلِي، أُمِّي قَاعِدَة تِحَضِّرُ مَنْسَف وَ قَطَايِف
dialogue.transliteration: 3ind ahli, ummi gaa3da ti7addér mansaf w-2ataayef
dialogue.english: At my parents', my mom is preparing mansaf and qatayef

dialogue.speaker: لَيْلَى
dialogue.arabic: يَا إِلاَهِي، بِلَعِت رِيقِي، أَنَا بِدِّي أَجَرِّب القَطَايِف تِبْعِهَا
dialogue.transliteration: ya ilahi, bila3et rii2i, ana biddi ajarrib l-2ataayef teba3a
dialogue.english: Wow, my mouth is watering, I want to try her qatayef

dialogue.speaker: هُدَى
dialogue.arabic: تِعَالِي مَعَنَا لَوْ بِدِّك، فِي مَكَان إِلَك عَالسِّفْرَة
dialogue.transliteration: ti3aali ma3ana law biddik, fi makaan ilak 3as-sifra
dialogue.english: Come with us if you want, there's a place for you at the table

dialogue.speaker: لَيْلَى
dialogue.arabic: يَسْلَمُو كِتِير، بَس عِنْدِي عَزِيمَة عِنْدِ خَالِتِي
dialogue.english: Thank you so much, but I have an invitation at my aunt's

dialogue.speaker: هُدَى
dialogue.arabic: تَمَام مَبْرُوك عَلَيْكِ الشَّهْرُ، وَتَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ صِيَامِك
dialogue.transliteration: tmam mabrook 3aleek sh-shahr, w-ta2abbal allah siyaamak
dialogue.english: Alright, blessed month to you, and may God accept your fasting

dialogue.speaker: لَيْلَى
dialogue.arabic: مِنَّا وَ مِنْكِ، اللَّهُ يُوَفِّقِنَا نِصُوم الشَّهْر كُلُّو
dialogue.transliteration: minna w-mink, allah ywaffe2na nisoom sh-shahr kullu
dialogue.english: From us and from you, may God help us fast the whole month

pair.english: May you be well this year

response.english: And may you be well too

lessons.culture: بِرَمَضَان بِالحِجَاز يِجْتَمِعُو عَالفِطْرِ، وَالعَزَايِم بِتَكُون كِتِير بِينَ الأَهْل وَالجِيرَان. القَطَايِف وَالحَلْوِيَات التَّقْلِيدِيَّة لاَ تِغِيب عَنِ السِّفْرَة. كِتِير مِنِ النَّاس تِقْرَأ القُرْآن وَتِصِلِّي التَّرَاوِيح.

exercises.prompt: حَدّا قَالَك رَمَضَانُ كَرِيم، شُو بِتِرِدّ عَلَيْه؟

too_formal.item: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ فِي الشَّهْرِ الفَاضِل
too_formal.feedback: كَلاَم فَصِيح رَسْمِي، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو شِي أَقْصَر.

exercises.tip: اللَّهُ أَكْرَم أَقْصَر رِدّ وَ أَكْثَرُو اسْتِعْمَالاً.

exercises.prompt: إِحْنَا ____ مِنَ الفَجْرِ لِحَتَّى المَغْرِب

too_formal.feedback: وَصْفٌ فَصِيحٌ طَوِيل، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو صَايِمِينَ بِكِلْمَة وَاحِدَة.

exercises.tip: صَايِم للْمُذَكَّرِ وَ صَايِمَة للْمُؤَنَّث.

exercises.prompt: What time is iftar today?

too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو السَّاعَة كَمِ.

exercises.tip: الفِطْرُ وَ الإِفْطَار مُسْتَخْدَمِينَ الاثْنِينِ بِنَفْس المَعْنَى.

exercises.prompt: شُو بِيسَمُّو الأَكْلَة يِلِّي بِتِنُوكَل قَبْلَ الفَجْرِ بِوَقْتِ الصِّيَام؟

too_formal.feedback: وَصْفٌ فَصِيحٌ، بِالحِجَاز فِي اسْمٌ وَاحِدٌ بَسِيط السَّحُور.

exercises.tip: السَّحُور قَبْلَ أَذَان الفَجْرِ بِشِوَيّة.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: We're preparing for iftar

too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، بِالحِجَاز أَقْصَر وَ أَبْسَط.

exercises.tip: قَاعِدِينَ قَبْلَ الفِعْل تَعْنِي الاسْتِمْرَارِيَّة هَالحِين.

exercises.prompt: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ صِيَامُكُم، شُو بِتِرِدّ؟

too_formal.item: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَ مِنْكُمْ صَالِحَ الأَعْمَال
too_formal.feedback: الجُمْلَة الكَامِلَة الفَصِيحَة، بِالحَكِي اليَومِي مُخْتَصَرِهَا.

exercises.tip: هَالرِدّ بِيتِقَال بَس إِذَا حَدّا قَالَك تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ صِيَامُكُم قَبْلَهَا.

exercises.prompt: مِدْفَعُ الإِفْطَار ____

too_formal.feedback: وَصْفٌ فَصِيحٌ إِخْبَارِي، مش الاسْتِخْدَام اليَومِي.

exercises.tip: مِدْفَعُ الإِفْطَارِ بِيدُقّ وَقْتَ أَذَانِ المَغْرِبِ بِالضَّبْط.

exercises.prompt: Whose iftar invitation are you going to tonight?

too_formal.item: لَدَى مِنْ سَتَتَنَاوَلُ طَعَامَ الإِفْطَارِ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَة؟
too_formal.feedback: صِيَاغَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز أَبْسَط وَ أَقْصَر.

exercises.tip: عَزِيمَة هُنَا تَعْنِي دَعْوَة عَشَا أَو إِفْطَار.

exercises.prompt: شُو اسْمُ الحِلْوِ المَشْهُور بِرَمَضَانَ يِلِّي هُو فَطَايِرُ مَحْشِيَّة جَوْز أَوْ قَشْطَة؟

too_formal.feedback: تَعْبِيرٌ عَامٌ فَصِيح، مش اسْمُ أَكْلَة مُحَدَّدَة.

exercises.tip: القَطَايِفُ بِتِنْحَشَى جَوْزٌ أَو قَشْطَة وَ بِتِتِقَلَّى أَو تِتْخَبَز.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: Blessed Ramadan

too_formal.feedback: إِضَافَة فَصِيحَة زِيَادَة عَنِ الجُمْلَة المَطْلُوبَة بِالتَّمْرِين.

exercises.tip: التَّرْتِيب البَسِيط: الاسْمُ أَوَّلاً وَ بَعْدُهُ الصِّفَة.

reply.english: God willing, from your own celebration

dialogue.speaker: نُوَّة
dialogue.arabic: مَبْرُوك يَا فَاطِمَة، سِمِعْتِ إِنِّك عِرْسِك قَرِيب!
dialogue.transliteration: mabrook ya fatima, simi3ti ink 3irsik qareeb!
dialogue.english: Congratulations Fatima, I heard your wedding is soon!

dialogue.speaker: فَاطِمَة
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُبارِكُ فِيكِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ يَوْمُ الجُمُعَة
dialogue.transliteration: allah ybaarek fiik, in shaa allah yoom l-jum3a
dialogue.english: God bless you, God willing on Friday

dialogue.speaker: نُوَّة
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُسَعِّدُكِ وَ يُوَفِّقِك. شُو بِتِلْبِسِينَ؟
dialogue.english: May God make you happy and grant you success. What will you wear?

dialogue.speaker: فَاطِمَة
dialogue.arabic: بِلْبِسُ فُسْتَان أَبْيَض وَ إِنْتِ؟
dialogue.english: I'll wear a white dress, and you?

dialogue.speaker: نُوَّة
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا بِلْبِسُ العَنَابِي وَ رُوح مَعَ أُمِّي
dialogue.transliteration: ana bilbis l-3anabi w-roo7 ma3 ummi
dialogue.english: I'll wear navy and go with my mother

dialogue.speaker: فَاطِمَة
dialogue.arabic: الصَّالَة مِتِحَضِّرَة وَالكُوشَة حِلْوَة كِتِير
dialogue.english: The hall is ready and the stage is very beautiful

dialogue.speaker: نُوَّة
dialogue.arabic: حِلْوَة وَايِد! وَالزَّفَّة إِمْتَى تِبْدَأ؟
dialogue.english: Very beautiful! And when does the procession start?

dialogue.speaker: فَاطِمَة
dialogue.arabic: بَعْدِ العِشَاء، وَ تِدْخُل العَرُوس بِالفُسْتَان الأَبْيَض
dialogue.transliteration: ba3d l-3isha, w-tidkhul l-3aroos bil-fustaan l-abyad
dialogue.english: After dinner, and the bride enters in the white dress

dialogue.speaker: نُوَّة
dialogue.arabic: مِنِ المَدْعُوّين؟
dialogue.english: Who is invited?

dialogue.speaker: فَاطِمَة

dialogue.english: Family, the neighbors and friends

dialogue.english: I brought them money and a nice gift

lessons.culture: بِالحِجَاز العِرْسُ مُنَاسَبَة عَائِلِيَّة كَبِيرَة، الزَّفَّة تِطْلُعُ عَلَى صَوْتِ الطَّبْلِ والدَّبْكَة تِضَلّ مُسْتَمِرَّة. الغُرْفَة خَاصَّة لِلعَرُوسِ وَالعِرِيس بِتِسِتِقْبِلُ الضُّيُوف عَلَى الكُوشَة. المُهُورُ والهَدَايَا تِأْتِي بِأَشْكَال مِختِلِفَة.

exercises.prompt: حَدّا قَالَك مَبْرُوك العِرْس، شُو بِتِرِدّ عَلَيْه؟

too_formal.feedback: كَلاَم فَصِيح رَسْمِي، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو شِي أَقْصَر.

exercises.tip: هَالرِدّ بِيتِقَال لأَيّ حَدّا مِهْمَا كَان جِنْسُو.

too_formal.feedback: إِضَافَة فَصِيحَة، مش جُزْء مِنَ التَّعْبِيرِ اليَومِي.

exercises.tip: عِنْدِك بِتِتَغَيَّرُ حَسَب جِنْس وَ عَدَد اللِّي عَمّ تِحْكِي مَعُو.

exercises.prompt: When is their wedding?

too_formal.feedback: زِفَاف كِلْمَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو عِرْس.

exercises.tip: إِمْتَى هِي كِلْمَة السُّؤَال عَنِ الوَقْتِ بِالحِجَاز.

exercises.prompt: شُو بِيسَمُّو الرَّقْصَة الشَّعْبِيَّة يِلِّي بِيرْقُصُو بِالعِرْس؟

too_formal.feedback: وَصْفٌ فَصِيحٌ عَام، بِالحِجَاز اسْمٌ وَاحِدٌ الدَّبْكَة.

exercises.tip: الدَّبْكَة بِيرْقُصُو بِصَفّ وَاحِد مَاسِكِينَ إِيدٌ بِإِيد.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: The wedding procession is coming

too_formal.feedback: مَوْكِب وَقَادِم فَصِيحَتَان، بِالحِجَاز الزَّفَّة وَ جَايَّة.

exercises.tip: الزَّفَّة بِتِطْلُعُ مِنْ بَيْتِ العَرِيس عَلَى صَوْتِ الطَّبْل.

exercises.prompt: عِقْبَالِك، شُو بِتِرِدِّي؟

too_formal.item: إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ يَتَحَقَّقُ ذَلِك قَرِيبًا
too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، بِالحَكِي اليَومِي أَقْصَر.

exercises.tip: هَالرِدّ بِيَعْنِي إِنِّك مِتِمَنِّي نَفْس الشَّي يِصِير عِنْد اللِّي حَكَاك.

exercises.prompt: لِبِسِت فُسْتَان ____

too_formal.feedback: ثَوْب كِلْمَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو فُسْتَان.

exercises.tip: فُسْتَان العَرْس عَادَة بِيكُون أَبْيَض بِالتَّقْلِيد الحِجَازِي.

exercises.prompt: Who's invited to the wedding?

too_formal.feedback: المَدْعُوونَ وَ حَفْلِ الزِّفَافِ فَصِيحَتَان، بِالحِجَاز أَبْسَط.

exercises.tip: مِنِ المَدْعُوّين تِسْأَل عَنِ الضُّيُوف بِشَكْلٍ عَام.

exercises.prompt: شُو بِيسَمُّو المَكَان يِلِّي العَرُوسِينَ بِيوقِفُو فِيهِ؟

too_formal.feedback: وَصْفٌ فَصِيحٌ عَام، بِالحِجَاز اسْمٌ وَاحِدٌ الكُوشَة.

exercises.tip: الكُوشَة بِيكُون مُزَيَّنَة بِالوُرْدِ والأَضْوِيَة.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: Congratulations on the wedding

too_formal.feedback: إِضَافَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، مش المَطْلُوبَة بِالتَّمْرِين.

exercises.tip: الفَرَح هُنَا تَعْنِي حَفْلَةُ العِرْسِ نَفْسِهَا.

dialogue.speaker: مَايَا
dialogue.arabic: عِيدُ مِيلاَدٍ سَعِيد يَا رَامِي!
dialogue.english: Happy birthday Rami!

dialogue.speaker: رَامِي
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُسَلِّمُك يَا مَايَا، يُسَلِّمُو إِنِّك تِذَكَّرْتِي
dialogue.transliteration: allah yislmak ya maya, yislmu inak tzakkarti
dialogue.english: God keep you Maya, thank you for remembering

dialogue.speaker: مَايَا
dialogue.arabic: طَبْعًا، كَمِ صِرْتَ عُمُرِك اليَوْم؟
dialogue.english: Of course, how old did you turn today?

dialogue.speaker: رَامِي
dialogue.arabic: صِرْتُ خَمْسَة وَ عِشْرِين، حِسِّيتُ حَالِي كِبِرْتُ هَالحِينَ
dialogue.transliteration: sirtu khamsa w-3ashreen, hissitu hali kibert hal7een
dialogue.english: I turned twenty-five, I feel like I've gotten old now

dialogue.speaker: مَايَا
dialogue.arabic: هَهَا لاَ لَسِّا شَبّ، مَبْرُوك عَلَيْك
dialogue.english: Haha no you're still young, congratulations

dialogue.speaker: رَامِي
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يُبارِكُ فِيكِ، تَعَالِي عَالحَفْلَة اللَّيْلَة
dialogue.english: God bless you, come to the party tonight

dialogue.speaker: مَايَا
dialogue.arabic: أَكِيد بِرُوح، عَمّ يِحَضِّرُو الكَيْك؟
dialogue.english: Of course I'll come, are they preparing the cake?

dialogue.speaker: رَامِي
dialogue.arabic: إِيه، أُخْتِي عَمّ تِحَضِّرُو هَالحِينَ
dialogue.english: Yes, my sister is preparing it now

dialogue.speaker: مَايَا
dialogue.arabic: وَ شُو بِتِبِّي هَدِيَّة؟
dialogue.english: And what gift do you want?

dialogue.speaker: رَامِي
dialogue.arabic: وَلاَ شِي، حَضُورِك كَافِي وَ زِيَادَة
dialogue.english: Nothing, your presence is more than enough

dialogue.speaker: مَايَا
dialogue.arabic: لاَ خَلِّيني أَجِيب لَك شِي، اللَّهُ يُطَوِّل عُمُرِك وَ يِسَعِّدِك
dialogue.transliteration: la khallini ajeeb lak shi, allah ytawwel 3umrak w-yisa33idak
dialogue.english: No, let me bring you something, may God lengthen your life and make you happy

lessons.culture: بِالحِجَاز الفِرَاح بِيحْتِفِلُو بِعِيدِ الِميلاَدِ بِكَيْك وَشُمُوع مِثْلِ بِكُلِّ مَكَان، بَس التَّهْنِئَة الأَهَم بِتِضَلّ اللَّهُ يُطَوِّل عُمُرِك، وَهَاي العِبَارَة يِقُولُوهَا لأَيّ حَدّا مِنْ يِحِبُّو وَيِتِمَنّاوُ العُمُرُ الطَّوِيل مش بَس بِعِيدِ ميلاَدُو.

exercises.prompt: حَدّا قَالَك عِيدُ مِيلاَدٍ سَعِيد، شُو بِتِرِدّ عَلَيْه؟

too_formal.feedback: صِيَاغَة فَصِيحَة رَسْمِيَّة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو شِي أَقْصَر.

exercises.tip: اللَّهُ يُسَلِّمُك بِيتِقَال لِلشُّكْرِ فِي أَشْيَاء كِتِير.

too_formal.feedback: وَصْفٌ فَصِيحٌ طَوِيلٌ، بِالحِجَاز أَمْرٌ قَصِير طُفِّ.

exercises.tip: بِيتِطْفَى الشُّمُوعُ بِنَفْخَة وَاحِدَة وَ الكُلّ عَمّ يِغَنُّو.

exercises.prompt: Congratulations on the newborn

too_formal.feedback: إِضَافَة فَصِيحَة أَلْفٌ، مش ضَرُورِيَّة بِالتَّمْرِين.

exercises.tip: المَوْلُود هُنَا بِيَعْنِي الطِّفْل يِلِّي تَوَلِّدَ حَدِيثًا.

exercises.prompt: شُو بِيقُولُو لِحَدّا حَصَل عِنْدُو تَرْقِيَة بِالشُّغْل؟

too_formal.feedback: التَّرْقِيَة الوَظِيفِيَّة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز يِقُولُو التَّرْقِيَة.

exercises.tip: التَّرْقِيَة هُنَا تَعْنِي صِارَ بِمَنْصَبٍ أَعْلَى بِالشُّغْل.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: We're preparing the cake

too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، بِالحِجَاز أَقْصَر وَ أَبْسَط.

exercises.tip: قَاعِدِينَ قَبْلَ الفِعْل تَعْنِي الاسْتِمْرَارِيَّة.

exercises.prompt: كُلّ سَنَة وَ إِنْتَ طَيِّب، شُو بِتِرِدّ؟

too_formal.feedback: صِيَاغَة فَصِيحَة بَدِيلَة، مش الرِّدّ الشَّائِعُ بِالحِجَاز.

exercises.tip: الرِّدّ بِيتِغَيَّرُ حَسَب جِنْسِ اللِّي عَمّ تِحْكِي مَعُو، طَيِّب أَو طَيِّبَة.

too_formal.feedback: صِيَاغَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، بِالحِجَاز جُمْلَة قَصِيرَة.

exercises.tip: كَمِ هِي كِلْمَة السُّؤَالِ عَنِ الكَمِيَّة أَو العَدَد بِالحِجَاز.

exercises.prompt: What gift do you want?

too_formal.feedback: صِيَاغَة فَصِيحَة طَوِيلَة، بِالحِجَاز أَبْسَط وَ أَقْصَر.

exercises.tip: بِتِبِّي تَعْنِي رَاغِبُ بِالحِجَاز.

exercises.prompt: شُو بِيقُولُو لِحَدّا بِيتِمَنّاوُ عُمُرٌ طَوِيل؟

too_formal.feedback: جُمْلَة فَصِيحَة قَدِيمَة، بِالحِجَاز أَكْثَرُ شُيُوعًا اللَّهُ يُطَوِّل.

exercises.tip: هَاي العِبَارَةُ بِيتِقَالُهَا بِمُنَاسَبَات كِتِير مش بَس عِيدَ الميلاَد.

exercises.prompt: رَتِّب: Congratulations on the new house

too_formal.feedback: المَسْكَن كِلْمَة فَصِيحَة، بِالحِجَاز البَيْت.

exercises.tip: الترتيب: مبروك، ثم اسم الشيء، ثم صفته.

phrases.english: May he grow up in your care (lit. in your honour)

reply.english: Why did you go to the trouble? Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Majed
dialogue.arabic: ألف مبروك يا فيصل! مبروك ما جاك.
dialogue.transliteration: alf mabrook ya faySal! mabrook ma jaak.
dialogue.english: A thousand congratulations, Faisal! Congratulations on your new arrival.

dialogue.speaker: Majed
dialogue.arabic: وكيف أمّه؟ إن شاء الله بخير.
dialogue.transliteration: w-keef ummu? in shaa2 allaah bikhayr.
dialogue.english: And how is his mother? Well, God willing?

dialogue.speaker: Majed
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله، اسم حلو.
dialogue.english: Mashallah, a lovely name.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: تعال شوفه، نايم دحين في سريره.
dialogue.transliteration: ta3aal shoofu, naayim da7een fi sireeru.
dialogue.english: Come and see him, he's asleep in his cot now.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: إيوه، كلّهم يقولوا كدا!
dialogue.english: Yes, everyone says so!

pair.english: May God bless the newborn for you (to a man)
What did you name him? (to a man)
May he grow up in your care (lit. in your honour)

response.english: Why did you go to the trouble? Thank you.

lessons.culture: In Jeddah, relatives and friends call on a new baby in the first weeks: the women visit the mother and the men congratulate the father, often with baby clothes or a little gold as a gift. Many families hold an عقيقة (3ageega) on the seventh day, sacrificing a sheep and sharing the meal with family and neighbours.

exercises.prompt: A friend says to you: "الله يبارك لك فيه". Reply.

too_formal.feedback: The classical word order. In conversation Hejazis put الله first: الله يبارك فيك.

exercises.tip: This blessing and its answer are shared across dialects.

exercises.prompt: Your friend asks: "إيش سمّيته؟" Say you named him Yusuf.

too_formal.feedback: أسميته is the written verb. In speech: سمّيته.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "البيبي شبه _____ مرّة." (The baby looks a lot like his father.)
exercises.tip: مرّة (marra) after a word or phrase means "very" or "a lot" in Hejazi.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "سمّيناه على اسم _____." (We named him after his grandfather.)
exercises.tip: Naming a first son after his father's father is a strong custom.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "What did you name him?" (to a man)

too_formal.feedback: ماذا is written Arabic. Hejazis ask with إيش.

exercises.tip: إيش (eesh) is the Hejazi "what".

exercises.prompt: Translate: "We came to visit the mother and the baby."

too_formal.feedback: جئنا and لزيارة are written forms. Spoken: جينا نزور.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "A gift for the newborn."

too_formal.feedback: هذه is written Arabic; Hejazis say دي for a feminine noun.

exercises.prompt: Which one means "May God make him righteous"?
exercises.tip: A prayer for any child, shared across dialects.

exercises.prompt: What is the feast for a newborn on the seventh day called?
Put the words in order: "البيبي / سرير / دا" (This is the baby's cradle.)
exercises.tip: دا (da) is "this" before a masculine noun, دي (di) before a feminine one: دي هديّة.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: "عزّك / في / يتربّى" (May he grow up in your care.)
exercises.tip: The usual answer is الله يعزّك, "may God honour you".

reply.english: Thank you, it's thanks to your prayers.

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: بشّر! إيش صار؟
dialogue.english: Good news? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.arabic: الله يبارك فيك، دا من فضل الله.
dialogue.transliteration: allah yibaarik feek, da min faDl allaah.
dialogue.english: God bless you, it's by God's grace.

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: وإمتى حفلة التخرّج؟
dialogue.english: And when is the graduation ceremony?

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.arabic: الخميس الجاي. وكمان لقيت وظيفة في شركة هنا في جدّة!
dialogue.transliteration: il-khamees ij-jaay. w-kamaan ligeet waZeefa fi sharika hina fi jidda!
dialogue.english: Next Thursday. And I've also found a job at a company here in Jeddah!

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.arabic: آمين يا رب، وإيّاك.
dialogue.english: Amen, O Lord, and you too.

pair.english: What is your result? (to a man)
We are proud of you (to a man)

response.english: Thank you, it's thanks to your prayers.

lessons.culture: In Jeddah a graduation is a family event: relatives phone with مبروك, and many families hold a small party at home for the graduate. A new job is met with الله يوفّقك and الله يفتح لك أبواب الخير, and the graduate usually thanks God and the family's prayers rather than himself.

exercises.prompt: A friend says: "مبروك التخرّج". Reply.

too_formal.feedback: The classical order. Spoken: الله يبارك فيك.

exercises.prompt: Your uncle asks: "إيش نتيجتك؟" Say you got excellent, praise God.

too_formal.feedback: This is how a certificate reads. In speech: جبت ممتاز.

exercises.tip: جبت (jibt), "I got", literally "I brought".

exercises.prompt: Complete: "النتايج _____ اليوم." (The results came out today.)
exercises.tip: In Saudi Arabia results "come down" (نزلت): they are posted online.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "إحنا مرّة _____ فيك." (We are very proud of you.)
exercises.tip: مرّة (marra) is the Hejazi "very".

exercises.prompt: Translate: "May God grant you success." (to a man)

too_formal.feedback: The classical order. Spoken: الله يوفّقك.

exercises.tip: This blessing is shared across dialects.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "He got a new job."

too_formal.feedback: حصل على is the written phrase. In speech: لقى.

exercises.prompt: Which one is the graduation cap?
A friend has just started a new job. What do you say?
Put the words in order: "الامتحانات / كل / في / نجحت" (I passed all my exams.)
Put the pieces in order: "أبواب الخير / يفتح لك / الله" (May God open the doors of good for you.)
exercises.tip: A blessing for a graduate or anyone starting out, shared across dialects.

reply.english: Beyond words, the best days of my life.

phrases.transliteration: jibt lakum tamr wi moyat zamzam

reply.arabic: أبشر، ما أنساكم إن شاء الله
reply.transliteration: abshir, ma ansaakum in shaa2 allaah
reply.english: Of course, I won't forget you, God willing.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: حجّ مبرور وسعي مشكور وذنب مغفور يا حاج صالح.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ajj mabroor wa sa3y mashkoor wa dhanb maghfoor ya 7aaj Saali7.
dialogue.english: An accepted Hajj, an appreciated effort and a forgiven sin, Hajj Salih.

dialogue.speaker: Saleh
dialogue.arabic: إيوه، رحنا المدينة بعد الحج وصلّينا في الحرم.
dialogue.transliteration: eewa, ri7na il-madeena ba3d il-7ajj wi Sallayna fil-7aram.
dialogue.english: Yes, we went to Madinah after the Hajj and prayed in the Haram.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmad
dialogue.arabic: جزاك الله خير، دي أحسن هديّة.
dialogue.transliteration: jazaak allaahu khayr, di a7san hadiyya.

lessons.culture: In Jeddah and Makkah, family and neighbours call on a returning pilgrim at home and greet him with حجّ مبرور وسعي مشكور وذنب مغفور. The pilgrim serves zamzam water and dates and hands out small gifts such as prayer rugs and prayer beads, and guests ask him to remember them in his prayers.

lessons.culture: A death is met with إنّا لله وإنّا إليه راجعون, and in Saudi Arabia the burial follows quickly, usually after the next prayer. Many Hejazi families receive condolences at home for three days, men and women in separate rooms; visitors say عظّم الله أجركم, sit a short while over Arabic coffee and dates, and are thanked with شكر الله سعيكم.

exercises.prompt: At a condolence visit you say "عظّم الله أجركم". What does the family answer?
exercises.tip: You may also hear شكر الله سعيك. These formulas are shared across dialects.

lessons.culture: Visiting the sick is a valued duty, and the visitor often says لا بأس، طهور إن شاء الله, the words the Prophet (peace be upon him) said when he visited a sick man. In Jeddah visitors keep the visit short, bring fruit, flowers or dates, and ask the patient to reassure them: طمّنّا عليك.

lessons.culture: When bad news comes, Hejazis comfort each other with God's decree, كلّه مكتوب and قدر الله وما شاء فعل, and with practical help rather than long speeches. A friend who has lost a job is told الله يعوّضك بأحسن منها, and his friends ask around for work for him.

challenge.title: هَنِّي صَاحِبِك عَالمُنَاسَبَة
challenge.instructions: اخْتَار مُنَاسَبَة (عِيد، رَمَضَان، عِرْس، أَو عِيدُ ميلاَد) وَاكْتُب حِوَار قَصِير بِيْنِك وَ بَيْنَ صَاحِبِك تِهِنِّيهِ فِيهِ وَ هُو يِرِدّ عَلَيْك.
